name: gridcraft-mcp-server
description: Build, edit, read and convert spreadsheets with the GridCraft app installed on Windows, macOS or Linux: sheets with live formulas, tables, formats, conditional formatting, charts and PivotTables, xlsx, csv, json, html and pdf. Not affiliated with GridCraft or Storytold.
long_description:
Work on spreadsheets with the GridCraft you already have installed on Windows, macOS or Linux (tested with 0.6.1 on Windows 11), the open-source, Excel-class spreadsheet app.

- **Create** workbooks from sheets of values and live formulas (513 Excel functions, dynamic arrays): header styling, tables with filter buttons, totals rows, number formats, fonts, colours, borders, merged cells, conditional formatting, drop-down lists, notes, charts (17 types), PivotTables, frozen panes and print setup.
- **Edit** existing xlsx, ods or csv files: write values and formulas, find and replace, insert and delete rows and columns, sort, remove duplicates, add, rename or delete sheets.
- **Read and calculate**: computed values, formulas or display text of any range, and formulas evaluated without changing the file; every result shows the first rows and any formula errors.
- **Convert** between xlsx, xlsm, xls, xlsb, ods, csv, tsv and json in, and xlsx, csv, tsv, json, html and pdf out.
- **Advanced**: run any of GridCraft's 339 engine commands and open workbooks in the GridCraft app.

The connector drives GridCraft's own headless engine (gridcraft-cli). Everything runs locally with no network access; originals are only read and files are never overwritten unless you ask. GridCraft is an open-source project by Storytold; this connector is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

gridcraft_dir.title: GridCraft folder
gridcraft_dir.description: Install folder of GridCraft (or GridCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\GridCraft, /Applications/GridCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/gridcraft or PATH.

gridcraft_cli.title: gridcraft-cli executable (optional)
gridcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped the gridcraft-cli zip on macOS.

control_port.title: GridCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the GridCraft app (open_in_gridcraft, run_gridcraft_commands live). Default 7979.
